pool.text: Spanish navigator Álvaro de Saavedra Cerón visited Pohnpei shortly before his death.
Australian sailor John Henry Rowe arrived in his barque John Bull at Pohnpei.
Protestant missionaries from New England established themselves permanently on Pohnpei.
A drastic population decline struck Pohnpei due to a smallpox epidemic.
The CSS Shenandoah surprised four United States whalers at Ascension Island and destroyed them.
German naturalist Otto Fischer wrote an ethnographic account of the island inhabitants.
Spaniards claimed the Caroline Islands and began to exert political authority.
The German Empire purchased the Caroline Islands from Spain together with other islands.
The feudal land tenure system was gradually replaced with individual land deeds.
Japan surrendered and Pohnpei was turned over to the United States.
A special census showed a total population of 5,628 people on Pohnpei.
Pohnpei became a central location in Willard Price's Young Adult Adventure Series.
The population on Pohnpei had grown to nearly 10,000 residents.
An important archaeological site on Pohnpei was declared a national historic site.
The Federated States of Micronesia achieved independence after United States administration.
